decisions: Minutes from the December 8, 2024 board meeting approved as amended with correction to Q4 budget figures.

2025 operating budget approved with a $17.4 million revenue target, $300,000 increase in technology infrastructure spend, and a 5% contingency reserve; formal budget document to be circulated by January 20, 2025.

Board approved pursuing expanded engagement with Northwind Partners across their European logistics arm and sustainability division; Aiyana Park authorized to recruit one senior consultant and one junior analyst; Pierre Dubois to finalize contract proposal with a minimum 12-month commitment clause ahead of January 22, 2025 client meeting; Margaret Holvan to lead client presentation.

Phase 2 digital transformation deadlines reaffirmed: full client portal deployment by February 28, 2025, and CRM-billing integration by March 31, 2025; Aiyana Park to provide written status update at next board meeting.

7% salary adjustment approved for senior associates and managers effective April 1, 2025; performance-based retention bonus program approved in principle with detailed framework to be developed by Pierre Dubois and Aiyana Park for board review by February 15, 2025.

All board members to submit client appreciation event guest nominations by January 31, 2025; Pierre Dubois to manage professional liability insurance renewal and report material changes; next board meeting confirmed for February 9, 2025.
